title: Interpreting normal variation across individual and population sources
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Use original volunteer MRA, arterial occurrence, venous field dispersion, cerebellar assignment and observer support to distinguish the types of evidence used when discussing normal anatomical variation. Compare independent sources without coordinate transfer or unsupported named-variant diagnosis.

views.prompt: Describe only this original volunteer image and annotation. Separate vessel signal, source label coverage and any candidate individual-variation interpretation.
